t: Multi-format rendering — Universal Result Delivery Manager
title: Multi-format rendering — Universal Result Delivery Manager
description:
The universal result delivery manager is the last mile of the archive: it takes a result set and renders it into whatever shape the consumer needs — plain text, structured JSON, downloadable files, deep links, emails, or API payloads. One retrieval pipeline serves a phone screen, a data scientist's notebook, and a print report without forking logic. Delivery is policy-aware: format, redaction, and channel are chosen per consumer, per record.

This record documents the multi-format rendering approach: Render one result set as text, JSON, CSV, HTML, PDF, or Markdown from a single pipeline.

Teaching ladder rank 1 (foundations): this record explains the core idea in plain terms — what inputs the tool takes, what outputs it produces, and when it is the right choice for an archive task.

Every record in this database is the full fully-formed file with all data — never a stub or description alone. This database holds 15 of the 1,000,000 target — the march to a million is in progress.
provenance: Public-harvest: documents established, real-world methods for universal result delivery manager; fact-checked public knowledge.
